title: Reading a caregiver's face before reacting to something new
summary: Most children glance at your face to decide how to react in a new situation by about 2 years, the milestone sheet says.
body: The child takes a clue from the caregiver's expression when the setting is unfamiliar. sheet places that glance on the 2-year social list, next to registering that someone else is harmed or distressed. The two lines are not the same skill. Most children, at 75 percent or more, is the series rule, and the page is not a clinical test. Only this country's chart is cited.

sources.title: Milestones by 2 Years
